attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as router between lan-a (node2, 10.50.10.0/24) and lan-b (node3, 10.50.20.0/24) with a default-drop forward filter that allows only established/related traffic plus new TCP port 5432 from lan-a to lan-b; all other cross-lan traffic (tested with TCP 8080 and ICMP) is rejected. Verified functionally before and after restarting each of the three managed nodes one at a time, confirming boot-identity change and full recovery of interfaces, routes, VyOS firewall config, and policy behavior on every node.
